Google actions · day by day (through Wed, Jul 29)

ℹ️
What these numbers mean: Directions is someone tapping for driving directions to you, the strongest free signal you get because it means they intend to visit. Calls is someone tapping the call button on your listing. Website is someone clicking through to your site. How to read a single week: call volume runs at a handful a week, so one or two calls either way will show as a large percentage without meaning much. Watch the shape across four weeks rather than any single week, and treat direction requests as the number that matters most. This week: directions up 57%, calls up 67% and website clicks up 31%. Every line moved the right way. The absolute numbers are small because the listing is young, so treat these as a trend forming rather than a result. Last week button: this block carries one. Press it and it redraws against the week before.

Google reviews

ℹ️
Why this matters more than almost anything else on the page: Google decides who to show on the map using how many reviews you have and how recently they arrived, not only your star rating. That is why a community can hold the best rating in its market and still be found below competitors with far more reviews. You are rated 4.7, level with the best in your market, on 9 reviews against competitors holding 223, 232, 268 and 547. You are not outrated, you are outnumbered. Nothing on this page would move faster than getting to 30 reviews. Last week button: there is none here. The small chart already shows six weeks side by side, so it does not need one.

Search presence (verified search data)

ℹ️
What these numbers mean in plain terms: Impressions is how many times you appeared in a search result. Clicks is how many times someone actually chose you. Click through rate is the share who chose you once they saw you, so it measures how appealing your listing looks. Keywords is how many different searches you show up for at all, which is the size of your net. This week: organic traffic up 138% and 168 keywords, from a standing start.
